headline: Liverpool's Virgil van Dijk: Don't view Man City rivalry differently despite guilty verdict
description: Virgil van Dijk has said he does not view the rivalry between Liverpool and Manchester City differently in light of the latter's guilty verdict but admitted he will share his opinion on the matter when the process has concluded.

headline: Man City 'more together than ever' after chants about charges - Elliot Anderson
description: Manchester City midfielder Elliot Anderson has said the criticism the club has received in the wake of being found guilty of financial irregularities has galvanised the players.

headline: Liverpool must drop Florian Wirtz - Jamie Carragher
description: Jamie Carragher has said Florian Wirtz should be dropped from the Liverpool lineup after another disappointing performance in Sunday's defeat to Manchester City.

headline: The Premier League's new villains: Anfield gives Man City a taste of what's to come
description: Man City faced fury at Anfield after being found guilty of cheating, but Erling Haaland and Co. answered the hostility with an emphatic 3-0 win.
